result.reason: The clause implements the preferred mutual cap, but the supplied operative language does not define “Excluded Claims” or establish the required carve-outs; the margin comment’s reference to Sections 21.2 and 21.3 cannot substitute for operative text. It also lacks the preferred mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages and clarification that Customer payment obligations are not damages subject to the cap. Accordingly, even fallback compliance cannot be confirmed from the rendered clause. The changes made are otherwise focused and professionally drafted.
